sql: WITH ni AS (SELECT s.name, s.sic, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM num WHERE adsh = s.adsh AND tag = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND ddate = 20260630 AND qtrs = 1 AND uom = 'USD'), (SELECT value FROM num WHERE adsh = s.adsh AND tag = 'ProfitLoss' AND ddate = 20260630 AND qtrs = 1 AND uom = 'USD') - COALESCE((SELECT value FROM num WHERE adsh = s.adsh AND tag = 'NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest' AND ddate = 20260630 AND qtrs = 1 AND uom = 'USD'), 0)) AS v FROM sub s WHERE s.form = '10-Q' AND s.period = 20260630) SELECT name FROM ni WHERE v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1
